free_tier.stated: USD 100 to USD 1,000 in GPU compute credits to train models, build tools or create tutorials, on RTX 4090, RTX 5090 and RTX PRO 6000 GPUs. Eligibility is aimed at Emmy compiler builders, researchers, open-source maintainers, indie developers, content creators, and artists and designers. Applications are reviewed every two weeks.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: USD 1,000 of RTX 4090 time at consumer-GPU rates is a usable quantity of inference or fine-tuning, and it composes with a public GitHub repository as the evidence the application needs. It does not stack with a second grant.

limits.value: A biweekly human review of the project fails first; the amount tops out at USD 1,000, which is hours of a consumer GPU rather than a training run.
